test_names: CONTAINED: rolling back a NEVER-DEPLOYED change is caught + escalated loudly (typed lifecycle error, never a silent no-op)
TRUTHFUL: the failed rollback leaves the system in a truthful state (lifecycle kept, transitions queryable, no fabricated outcomes)
CONTAINED: rolling back an ALREADY-ROLLED-BACK deployment is caught (terminal state) and the history stays queryable
CONTAINED (action surface): a rollback whose executor FAILS is a typed FAILED receipt in the durable event log (never a fake success)
TRUTHFUL (action surface): an unobservable rolled-back state is recorded honestly as UNKNOWN — never fabricated VERIFIED
terminal_state: CONTAINED + TRUTHFUL: typed DeploymentLifecycleError for impossible rollbacks with the state kept truthful (DRAFT/RETIRED, transitions retained, no fabricated outcomes); executor-failed rollbacks durable as action.failed; unobservable rolled-back states honestly UNKNOWN
detection_containment: the deployment store refuses loudly and mutates nothing (statusOf stays UNAVAILABLE, outcomesOf empty)
the gateway records the FAILED rollback in the event log with failure.errorType and truthful evidence records
the rollback verification says UNKNOWN with the not-observed limitation when the target cannot be observed
retained_uncertainty: an unobservable rolled-back state stays UNKNOWN (the limitation names what was not observed)
notes: The suites ran twice at the verified head (identical results) and re-ran green at the delivery head (the evidence-only follow-up commit that fills verified_head_revision with the exact code-head sha and adds only these records). Fixed vitest seed 424242; fully offline (every clock, store, seam and probe injected).
